title: Transportation Planner — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Plans public transit, walking, biking, and driving routes for students. The Transportation Planner helps plan public transit, walking, biking, or driving. It compares options for each trip — bus routes and schedules, bike time, walk time, driving with parking — showing cost, time, and reliability side by side. Recurring trips like the commute to an internship get saved as named routes.
